body: Chrome 154 chrome.debugger Fetch facts (observed, spike/probe-redirect-cookie.mjs): Fetch responseHeaders never include Set-Cookie (use Network.responseReceivedExtraInfo); fulfillRequest cannot keep a Set-Cookie out of the jar (DNR set-cookie remove can); continueRequest without a Cookie header attaches the shared jar, with one (even empty) replaces it; DNR header mods are applied BEFORE the Fetch pause, so a rule installed during the pause is too late (debugger-as-barrier fails); Target.createBrowserContext is Not allowed; 'debugger' cannot be an optional permission. Google ServiceLogin sets __Host-GAPS on its first 302 and re-mints it if the follow-up lacks it. See docsi/research/google-signin.md.
